summary: Perma-Pipe International Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new secured credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent, replacing its existing credit facility. The new facility comprises a $75 million revolving line (with sub-limits for letters of credit and swingline loans) and a $14 million term loan, maturing August 25, 2031. Proceeds repaid existing borrowings; $23 million was drawn on the revolver. This is a routine credit facility refinancing for working capital and general purposes, not a special situation, with no deal terms relevant to M&A or restructuring.
